lines.text: Many learners say: I want you help me.
Better: I want you to help me.
You to! Say: I want you to help me.

data.right: I want you to help me.
data.memory: I want you to help me.

native.hook: 「手伝ってほしい」は want you help？
native.tip: 「〜してほしい」は want＋人＋to＋動詞。to を落とさないように。
native.caption: “I want you help me.”と言っていませんか？😅 「あなたに手伝ってほしい」を言うとき、to を落としがちです。“I want you to help me.” が自然な言い方です。Amaの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“you to”。“I want you to help me.” を声に出して言ってみよう。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.caption: Do you say this? “I want you help me.” 😅 Do not forget to after want you. The natural way is “I want you to help me.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
